CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.trigger_dispatch_enqueue()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_sessions m
  join mission_academy_owner.policies p on p.mission_id=m.mission_id and p.active
  where m.id=new.master_session_id and m.owner_kind='human'
   and m.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
   and exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.human_d100_permits_v1 permit
    where permit.master_session_id=m.id and permit.source_message_id=new.source_ref
     and permit.transaction_id=txid_current() and permit.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid())
   and exists(select 1 from mission_creation_owner.human_directions dir
      where dir.event_id=(new.result->>'event_id')::uuid and dir.master_session_id=m.id
       and dir.actor_user=m.master_user)
   and exists(select 1 from public.mission_run_outbox ob
      where ob.event_id=(new.result->>'event_id')::uuid and ob.master_session_id=m.id
       and ob.state='human_directed'))
 then return new;end if;
 -- Preserve the native Academy permit branch above. General Human direction is
 -- admitted only for the assigned authenticated Master and immutable native event.
 if exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_sessions m
  join public.mission_run_events e on e.master_session_id=m.id
   and e.id=(new.result->>'event_id')::uuid and e.status='committed'
  join public.mission_run_outbox ob on ob.master_session_id=m.id and ob.event_id=e.id
   and ob.state='human_directed' and ob.event_version_after=e.version_after
   and ob.step_key=e.step_after and ob.context_fingerprint=e.context_fingerprint
  join mission_creation_owner.human_directions dir on dir.event_id=e.id
   and dir.master_session_id=m.id and dir.actor_user=m.master_user
   and dir.step_key=ob.step_key and dir.run_control_version=ob.event_version_after
   and dir.event_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(to_jsonb(e))
  where m.id=new.master_session_id and m.owner_kind='human'
   and auth.uid() is not null and m.master_user=auth.uid()
   and mission_public_owner.human_fato_scope_allowed_v2(m.id))
 then
  perform mission_creation_owner.human_assert(new.master_session_id);
  return new;
 end if;
 perform mission_generic_owner.enqueue_transition(new.master_session_id,new.id);
 return new;
end;
$function$

args: p_observation jsonb, p_arc uuid, p_active boolean, p_context jsonb

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_factory_owner.human_verified_context_valid_v1(p_context jsonb, p_base text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 RETURN p_base='5ab4234b32294cc26472855447e6230f62c5e07308768816ae0c2ea304d94366' AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(p_context,ARRAY['schema_version','backend_pid','transaction_started_at','statement_started_at','principal','auth_role','base_release_sha256','observation','observation_sha256'])
 AND p_context->>'schema_version'='human-server-command-context/1' AND (p_context->>'backend_pid')::integer=pg_backend_pid()
 AND (p_context->>'transaction_started_at')::timestamptz=transaction_timestamp() AND (p_context->>'statement_started_at')::timestamptz=statement_timestamp()
 AND (p_context->>'principal') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM auth.uid()::text AND (p_context->>'auth_role') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM auth.role()
 AND p_context->>'base_release_sha256'=p_base AND p_context->>'observation_sha256'=mission_factory_owner.sha(p_context->'observation')
 AND p_context#>>'{observation,schema_version}'='human-compatible-release-identity/1' AND p_context#>>'{observation,provenance_release_sha256}'=p_base
 AND p_context#>>'{observation,revision_sha256}'=p_base AND p_context#>>'{observation,state}'='enabled'
 AND p_context#>>'{observation,scope}'='staff' AND p_context#>'{observation,staff_guards_verified}'='true'::jsonb AND p_context#>'{observation,published_assets_verified}'='true'::jsonb
 AND p_context#>>'{observation,canonical_preimage}' IS NOT NULL AND encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p_context#>>'{observation,canonical_preimage}','UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')=p_base
 AND p_context#>>'{observation,observed_revision_sha256}' IS NOT NULL;
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR datetime_field_overflow THEN RETURN false;
END;
$function$

args: p_session uuid, p_master boolean, p_context jsonb
